analysis.canvasSummary: A polished Chinese corporate annual strategy and performance infographic. The left half contains a branded smart-city hero, strategy cards, a 2025 roadmap, capability pillars, and company values. The right half contains 2024 KPI cards, a business-structure donut chart, a 2022–2025 performance chart, and a dark-blue closing statement band.
analysis.backgroundDescription: Nearly full-canvas white and pale-blue corporate backdrop with a smart-city skyline, distant mountains, translucent architectural overlays, luminous blue data waves, dotted patterns, and the dark-blue curved footer artwork. This coherent scene should be retained as one repaired high-fidelity raster background with all independently editable content removed.
